question: Sachin Tendulkar received the "Bharat Ratna Award" in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar** received the **Bharat Ratna Award **in the year** 2014**.
 
• The **Bharat Ratna** is the** highest civilian award in India**, given for exceptional service towards advancement of** art, literature and science,** and in recognition of public service of the highest order.
 
• Sachin Tendulkar is a** retired Indian cricketer **widely considered to be one of the** greatest batsmen** in the history of cricket.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna for his** contributions to Indian cricket.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Bharat Ratna **is the Republic of India's **highest civilian honor.**
 
• The award, which was established on **January 2, 1954**, is given in recognition of "exceptional service/performance of the highest order" and is given without regard to a **person's race, profession, position, or sex.**
 
• A **peepal leaf-shaped medallion** and a **Sanad (certificate) **with the President's signature are given to the recipients.
 
• The award is** not** accompanied by a financial grant.
 
• In the Indian hierarchy, those who have received the Bharat Ratna are **ranked seventh.**
